steps: Navigate with Tab from the skip link through tenant, principal, campaign, and submit controls.
Load the PostgreSQL snapshot and connect a header-authenticated SSE stream with a stale retention cursor.
Allocate a voucher with Enter and wait for the authoritative campaign snapshot refresh.
Capture the operator secret in memory, verify the password input is cleared, and reach allowed actions with Tab.
Open the confirmation dialog, cancel with Escape, and verify focus restoration.
Confirm pause with Enter, advance the revision externally, then submit the stale end form.
Verify the 412 handler refreshes the authoritative snapshot and revision before retrying end.
Inspect DOM, storage, cookie, and URL surfaces for the raw operator secret.
Confirm the tenant-scoped allocation-review scenario, render the open review queue, and approve it through a second confirmation dialog.
Verify the open queue clears and the reconciliation backlog is read through guarded same-origin operator GET routes.
Run the delayed duplicate/out-of-order scenario and verify stored APPLIED, IGNORED, and CONFLICT evidence.
Without reloading the page, run the capacity race and verify exactly two winners, six authoritative rejections, and zero remaining capacity.
Run the policy race and verify policy version 1 with authoritative capacity and remaining capacity 12.
Run the redeem/revoke race and verify the final claim is terminal and its capacity effect matches the winning state.
Verify each scenario reset closes the old EventSource, clears its cursor, and reconnects with HTTP 200 before capturing the final screenshot.

destructive scenario reset requires tenant-scoped confirmation
review queue renders and approve action requires confirmation
review and reconciliation operator GET routes return HTTP 200

redeem/revoke race persists one terminal claim and one matching capacity effect
